title: Streamgraph
intent: Show the changing composition of unemployment across every industry with a wiggle baseline and inside-out layer order.

ai.create: Create a responsive UTC streamgraph directly from the industries dataset's original date, industry, and unemployed fields using an areaY stack with a wiggle baseline and inside-out order.
ai.maintain: Change the stack order or offset while retaining raw industry rows, source identity, equivalent zero-origin wiggle semantics, and inferred interval points.
